title: Apply a house rule that lives in a rarely-triggered skill
prompt: Draft a short external-facing announcement that our EU data residency option is now available.
notes: The point of the whole benchmark. The house rule — never state a compliance capability without naming the certifying standard and its date — lives in a config's instructions. The prompt does not hint at it. A monolithic always-on file may bury the rule among many others; a progressively-disclosed skill either fires or does not. This task measures retrieval, not writing quality, so its rubric is near-binary and it is the cheapest task in the suite to run.
